notes.title: Arts & Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes: [list][*][p][b]NEW[/b]: Planets Visible toggle in Graphic Options![/p][/*][*][p]Game's art style reverted to the original.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Prisoners bubble positions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Anunnachy autobuy for Citizens Upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069880/a8519d3d9313425877e5f37198a02a37d8e67da4.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Your voice has come through loud and clear. As many of you know from the Early Access phase, this game has always been built around your feedback, and I underestimated how essential the visual identity was to the overall experience.[/p][p]With this recent art rework, I clearly missed the mark.[/p][p]First, I want to apologize for delaying the BigBang release due to the visual overhaul, and more importantly, for not involving you during these past months in this visual rework and for delivering an aesthetic that many of you felt didn’t match the game.[/p][p]After several miscommunications with the current artist, I’ve decided to [b]revert[/b] the game's art style back to its original version, which used AI-generated assets (outlined by hand by me, filled by AI). This will serve as a temporary solution until I’m certain I’ve found an artist who can fully reflect the game’s current style and mood, and bring you along for the journey in shaping the next visual rework together.[/p][p]Also for new new players who discovered the game with version 1.0 or for long-time players who were looking forward to the new art, I’m sorry for the sudden shift in visuals overnight as we return to the game’s original look.[/p][p]As always, I deeply appreciate your support and feedback. Being a solo developer, I genuinely couldn’t do this without your help.[/p][p]Lastly, if you purchased a skin from the Skin Tab during the 1.0 launch, and would like a refund, feel free to open a ticket in the Support section on Discord.[/p][p]Thank you again for sticking around.[/p][p]—[b]Soehnle[/b][/p]

notes.title: 1.0 Release
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069880/8de81748cc51606049de1417d57e705be3433416.png"][/img][b]The day has finally arrived![/b][/p][p]After a long wait, the full [b]Graphic rework[/b] and the long awaited [b]Big Bang[/b] update are here![/p][p]Here’s what you can expect:[/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: Full graphic rework. No more AI-generated images![/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: Big Bang (NG+) unlocked at SN #6 - BH #46![/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: +422 Steam Achievements![/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: "Move to next Area" button next to the zone tab to fast travel in the next Area![/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: Scrolling Tips! (toggleable from the Options menu)[/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: Overclock System Tab and Overclock Tokens to improve Mechs #1-2-3-4 Upgrades unlocked at BH #11![/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: Overclock Meteorite can appear in the Meteorite Minigame! (requires BH #11)[/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: New Code in Discord available![/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: Permanent achievements for Radiations and Minerals![/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: 1 Upgrade in Radiations Tab![/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: 1 Upgrade in Supernova Tab![/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: 1 BM perk![/p][p][/p][p]BigBang (NG+):[/p][p][/p][p]New Game+: Appears at SN #6, resets universe and supernova progress, unlocks new universes, resources and SN layers.[/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: Free Movement: Control your ship in any direction with WASD or arrow keys![/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: Buy Mech Tokens using AM for the entire Big Bang run![/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: Light Years time bonus grows up to 48x over 24h![/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: Quark resource & Tab with 50+ Upgrades![/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: Smoke Trails Passive in Skill Points Tab[/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: 2 new unlockable universes (Insane & Terror)[/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: +10 Item rarities[/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: BH journey passive at BH #45[/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: AM Tab with 6 Upgrades![/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: 2 new Misiks Tabs.[/p][p][b]NEW[/b]: 2 BM perk.[/p][p]And more in BigBang Infos.[/p][p]QoL Improvements & Changes:[/p][p]Doubled the initial spawn rate of the Radiations.[/p][p]Upgrades that increment base stats now show % values.[/p][p]Removed Kills and Zone achievements:[/p][p]- 1% Amethyst Meteorite moved to Meteorite Achievement[/p][p]- Piercing Clickshots moved to Radiations Tab[/p][p]- Homing Clickshots, Extra Clickshots, Mech #5 Shots moved to Projectiles Tab[/p][p]- Max Enemy Ships Alive moved to BH #1/4/7/9/12 passives[/p][p]- Clickshots Damage, Clickshots Bullet Speed, Extra BM moved to Infinite LY Tab[/p][p]Homing Clickshots will be kept in SN #1.[/p][p]Radiations automove bar kept in SN #4.[/p][p]Extra kills now works offline (for mech upgrades & skin unlocks).[/p][p]Prestige or Manual Travel can now be triggered during boss fights.[/p][p]Star System 1 enemies HP & Damage reduced by 50% during BB/SN/BH #0.[/p][p]Canvas OFF mode improved.[/p][p]Radiation Magnetic Bars now unlock after gathering 2500 Radiations.[/p][p]BH icon stops pulsing after 1000 kills when you still have Black Matter left.[/p][p]Antimatter Meteorite gives AM for first 50 destroyed Meteorites, then scales to Amethyst value x10. (resets every SN)[/p][p]Overclock Meteorite can be destroyed up to 50 times. (resets every SN)[/p][p]Daily Code now also grants 1 Overclock Token. (requires BH #11)[/p][p]Added some visual QoL.[/p][p] [/p][p]Fixes:[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed KPS.[/p][p]Fixed Prisoners drop.[/p][p]Fixed Insane Universe being accessible before BB.[/p][p]Fixed explosion animations and citizen timers.[/p][p]Fixed items drop/equip.[/p][p]Fixed lag from Skins / Stats / Multipliers / Zone tabs.[/p][p]Fixed HARD+ Meteorite impact.[/p][p]Fixed Area Skip perk.[/p][p]Fixed BH backups.[/p][p]Various fixes.[/p][p][/p]
